_doc: Edit tiles, activity and replies only. Tile fields: id, title (Marathi label), tag (tiny caption, optional), icon (coins|smartphone|sprout|clapperboard|scissors|images|activity|shield-check|radio|clock-3|gem), state (ok = लाइव्ह, warn = वाट, bad = अडचण, idle = शांत, run = चालू आहे with optional progress 0-100, done = पूर्ण), badge (optional label override), headline (one short line), note (optional), updated_at (UTC ISO time of the change), wide (optional true = full width). Tile order is display order. activity: list of {at: UTC ISO (optional), text}; newest five show and the rates publish line is added automatically. replies: list of {at: UTC ISO, text} - the agents' answers to his commands, newest last; the page shows the last six mixed with the commands he sent from this phone. Keep text short. No rate-source names. line: the phone number the command bar texts (E.164, + and digits only); change it here without touching the page code.
